budget_policy: Nested cumulative GPU-second caps including warmups and both arms; checkpoint at each sealed cap without altering work, seeds, metrics or repetitions. Count full allocated GPUs for all runtime phases, even phases excluded from reported timing. Report insufficient budget or stage timeout explicitly; require complete fixed protocol before claiming equivalence/performance. Intake stage wall limits remain additional constraints. Representative completion time and fit within budgets unverified.

confidence_rule.equivalence_decision: For each input sort 64 paired seed differences. With M=2 input-specific metric tests, allocate alpha/M per two-sided interval. Choose largest integer k with P(Binomial(64,0.5)<=k-1)<=alpha/(2*M); interval is [difference_(k), difference_(65-k)]. Require both endpoints strictly inside [-1,+1] for every test. Bonferroni family confidence at least 0.95. Ties use conservative coverage. No t approximations or nonsignificance-as-equivalence.
confidence_rule.performance_decision: Compute baseline_wall/method_wall for each timing pair. Require exact one-sided binomial order-statistic lower confidence bound for median speedup to exceed 1.05 on representative input. Keep five timing pairs within each seed; report seed dependence and use seed-level median ratios for final 64-observation decision.
confidence_rule.performance_order_statistics: For n independent seed-level ratios choose largest k with P(Binomial(n,0.5)<=k-1)<=0.05, and use sorted ratio_(k) as lower bound. Nonfinite or incomplete observations yield inconclusive; never silently drop them.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work Monte Carlo pricing benchmark with fixed options and paths; no calibrated budget-to-outcome curve. Require paired statistical equivalence and independent published anchor checks, not time-to-target extrapolation.

equivalence_metrics.definition: For each seed and input, baseline SE_i = baseline discounted Confidence_i/1.96, using unrounded per-option values from the baseline arm only. For each arm compute mean_i((MC_price_i - BS_price_i)/baseline_SE_i) over all options; equivalence observations are method minus baseline quantities paired by seed. A margin of 1 is one baseline SE averaged in these normalized coordinates.
equivalence_metrics.invalid_data_rule: Missing unrounded prices/confidences, nonfinite values, or nonpositive baseline SE invalidate this metric; never substitute a measured method variance or a zero tolerance.
equivalence_metrics.name: mean_standardized_price_error
equivalence_metrics.scientific_interpretation: Tests median paired shift of mean standardized pricing error. Does not establish per-option equivalence or equivalence of error tails. Normalization rule and positive margin fixed before method outputs.
equivalence_metrics.source: intake/brief.md and intake scoring evidence, pinned MonteCarlo_kernel.cu L167-L179: discounted Confidence = 1.96 times Monte Carlo standard error; MonteCarloMultiGPU.cpp L426-L442 supplies analytic Black-Scholes reference. No empirical baseline variance supplied. Scientific margin is prospectively chosen as one baseline Monte Carlo standard error in normalized units, not a published L1 tolerance.

evaluation_inputs.generation: Pinned host generator with srand(123), libc rand(), S in [5,50], X in [10,25], T in [1,5], R=0.06, V=0.10; 8192 options for anchor, 1048576 for representative; PATH_N=262144, default float, streamed strong scaling. Preserve generated arrays across arms. Freeze and record libc identity and generated-array hashes before method evaluation; hashes unavailable now.
evaluation_inputs.missing_evidence: No numeric baseline prices, Monte Carlo standard errors, reserve or L1 measurements supplied. Per-option extraction needed for sealed equivalence metric; aggregate console output alone insufficient.
evaluation_inputs.validation: Evaluate analytic Black-Scholes on every option. On anchor require unrounded reserve strictly >1 and published Test passed plus successful exit, separately for each arm and seed. Preserve strict comparison at rounded boundary. Record L1 without inventing acceptance threshold.

hardware_requirements: Use same host and two identical GPU models; baseline uses first GPU, method uses both. Record model, driver, CUDA, clocks, grid geometry, libc and environment; unknown at seal. Two-GPU method is explicit prospective departure from intake one-GPU baseline, supported only by supplied bounds. Report GPU-second cost as allocated GPU count times wall duration, including idle allocated devices; wall speedup does not imply cost savings.

paired_seed_tests.aggregation: For scientific equivalence use one observation per seed and input, never timing repetitions as independent scientific observations.
paired_seed_tests.availability: Pinned sample has no seed CLI and uses device-derived streams. Paired seed injection and canonical stream mapping are required adapter capabilities, currently unavailable evidence. If unsupported, evaluation is invalid; do not count identical stock runs as independent seeds.
paired_seed_tests.pairing: Same generated options and logical option/path random stream identifiers in both arms for each seed. Seed changes Monte Carlo streams, not host input generation.
paired_seed_tests.stream_specification: Prospective adapter requirement: key cuRAND streams by sealed seed plus canonical baseline logical block/thread identity and path index, independent of physical device assignment. Partition options across two devices without changing logical streams. Preserve float precision and 262144 paths per option.

interval_basis.limitations: Profile reports 1.150641998000026 s wall and two GPUs, whereas intake fixes baseline to one GPU. Profile workload identity and transferability to representative scale are unverified; retain supplied ceiling without claiming a validated scaling measurement.
interval_basis.overheads: Retain baseline host/API work and transfers. Extra fraction covers second-device launches, coordination, transfers and result merge; endpoints are planning assumptions, not measurements.
interval_basis.status: prospective assumption, not a measured gain or confidence interval

power.planning_alternative: For each input, independent seeds have probability at most 0.10 of a paired difference at or below -1, and at most 0.10 at or above +1.
power.rationale: 64 seeds permit finite exact binomial median bounds with Bonferroni over both input-specific metric tests. Under the stated tail-probability alternative, exact binomial probability that both interval endpoints lie within margins exceeds 0.90. Actual power unknown without baseline paired variability; failure never authorizes changing margin or sample size.
power.status: Conditional prospective design; no empirical power claim.

scheduling_protocol: Precompute seeded random permutation of input/seed/repetition pairs and independent fair baseline-first/method-first order within each pair. Run arms serially without other GPU workloads; synchronize and reset RNG before each arm. Archive order and raw timings. Do not select fastest repetitions.
seal_constraints: No method code or workload executed during seal. No gate script named or available within permitted sources. Scope, tolerance, seed, input or sample-size changes require new sealed run.

splits.calibration: Published 8192-option anchor only; no parameter or margin fitting permitted.
splits.rule: Representative case held out from method tuning and selected once; no scale search. Anchor prefix and representative generated sequence may overlap; no claim of independent option datasets. Statistical sampling unit is seed.

timing_scope.description: Reported streamed wall interval starts before option preprocessing and includes host launch/API time, H2D, GPU pricing, D2H, all-device completion waits and method result merge before stopping timer. Baseline includes analogous work. Exclude compilation, allocation, RNG initialization and Black-Scholes validation as intake specifies. Any merge moved outside stock reported interval must be brought inside measurement. Adapter synchronizes all participating GPUs at boundaries.

warmup_protocol: One complete untimed fixed-work run per arm and input, using seed 1000000 excluded from inference; charge GPU-seconds. No adaptive warmup. Restore paired RNG state before measured execution.
